lines.text: CALUMET COUNTY SHERIFF'S DEPARTMENT Page 757 File Number Complaint No. 05-0157-955

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: We just have to get some things on the record, um and you need to tell me if they're true. I was told by your attorney, Mr. Len Kachinsky, that you wanted to talk to us, is that true?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You need to talk cuz it's being recorded, if you could please.

lines.speaker: FAASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, ah, I was also told that Mr. Kachinsky spoke to you about this, is that true?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, ah, Mr. Kachin-Kachinsky also told us that ah no promises were made to you on behalf of the state. Is that true?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, ah because obviously you're in custody, we're gonna to go through that Miranda Warning again. You remember that?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: OK, I've got a form here I'm gonna use and I'm gonna go through that, if you have any questions, ask me, OK?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You have the right to remain silent, anything you say can and will be used against you in a court of law. You have the right to consult with a lawyer before questioning, and to have your lawyer present with you during questioning. If you cannot afford to hire a lawyer, one will be appointed to represent you a public expense before or during questioning if you so wish. If you decide to answer questions now without a lawyer present, you have the right to stop the questioning and to remain silent at anytime you wish, and the right to ask for and have a lawyer present at anytime you wish including during questioning. Would you like ta read those over?
